what: grid sensitivity of the erosional statistics on the as-operated case
why: Vm_peak_mps is a point maximum taken next to a flow reversal. This measures how far it, and four alternatives to it, move under refinement, so the README quotes a measurement rather than a recollection.

definitions.max_mps: max of the ensemble-median flux j (the solver's Vm_peak_mps)
definitions.p99_mps: 99th percentile of |j|, weighted by cell length
definitions.p95_mps: 95th percentile of |j|, weighted by cell length
definitions.km_over_limit: route length with |j| above the API RP 14E limit (the solver's erosional_exceedance_km)
definitions.peak_1km_mean_mps: peak of a 1 km running mean of |j|
